title: Plaza Theatre (El Paso)
scope: Restored 1930 Plaza Theatre exterior at 125 Pioneer Plaza, including the original entrance, historic auditorium and attached stage and entry wings.
limitations: OpenStreetMap and the USDA orthophoto establish the extents. Main heights, the secondary roof equipment and rear opening details are estimated.
The marquee’s decorative pattern and lettering are model geometry. The message board is unlettered and the interior is outside the scope.
The connected Centre Building and adjacent Art Museum are separate structures.
